subsystem.name: VehiclePhysics
subsystem.responsibility: Per-vehicle physics simulation state: tire-force and suspension/wheel dynamics solve, collision-damage accumulation with DNF detection, engine durability and thermal simulation, collision-shape initialization, wheel-group state dispatch and repair, and the vehicle selection/camera-tracking glue that routes game-state changes.

summary: Sixteen validated vehicle-physics functions reconstructed as ten worker-proposed classes. The dominant object is VehiclePhysicsSimulation, a single large per-vehicle state carrying engine durability/thermal data, collision-damage accumulation, suspension/wheel solver state, tire-force inputs, the physics-body name mapping and the active/contact/vibration flags. Two collision-shape initializers share a discriminator + data-pointer layout; a wheel-group dispatcher owns six-group slot decoding and the typed 3/4/5 state update, both resolving sentinel slots through the repair-state owner arrays. Audio and selection helpers are thin wrappers over scene and game-state dispatch helpers. All IR owners are UNKNOWN; the proposed owners are DERIVED/GUESS and several offset conflicts are recorded in unresolved rather than forced into a clean design.

function_roles.role: Cyclically shifts the player selection index (dword_7C54DC +/- 1, wrapped against the vehicle count dword_5C329C), dispatches game state for the newly selected vehicle via GameStateDispatchChain, refreshes every vehicle visual entry via sub_4F0D20, and returns the count.

Thin camera/game-state wrapper: reads the tracked-vehicle index dword_7C54E4, indexes the vehicle pointer array dword_7C54F0, and dispatches a game-state change for the tracked vehicle via GameStateDispatchChain.

Computes the averaged position of a packed array, lerps it with the bounding-box center using a mode-selected blend factor (0.35 for mode 2, else 0.70), adds a queried three-field offset, writes it back, and applies the offset vector to the object via GlobalVectorOffsetUpdate.

Initializes a physics collision shape: writes discriminator this+8, subtype constant 2 at this+1C and the data pointer at this+20, derives scaled distance-squared values from the bounding box, stores them via CollisionInvMassStore, bulk-writes six constant fields, writes four shape constants into the sub-struct at this+20, and honors an a4 override through ShortComputation_e770.

Initializes a physics collision shape: writes discriminator this+8, subtype constant 4 at this+1C and the external data pointer at this+20, stores inverse-mass 10.0 and six float constants via CollisionInvMassStore/F_6FieldBulkSetter, and honors an a4 override through ShortComputation_e770. Invoked by sub_40FE50.

Decodes a packed 36-byte wheel input record into 13 scaled floats and a 6-bit group selector, dispatches on the selector (jump table) into six wheel groups, validates each wheel index against a per-group count, resolves sentinel (-1) slots in groups 3-5 via the 4656-stride repair-state owner arrays through ShortComputation_e770 and RepairServiceStateDispatcher, and converts the slot physics state via PhysicsStateVectorConversion.

Dispatches a physics state update on operation type 3/4/5, each mapping to a distinct per-type array base (this+4C/+58/+64) and per-type global owner table; writes a float slot, runs ShortComputation_e770, SwitchBasedFloatProcessing and PhysicsStateVectorConversion, marks the element active at +10, and returns the conversion result.

Per-wheel tire contact-patch force computation: guards on tire-brand and compound lookups, combines two suspension/load force terms, aggregates wheel forces, applies a tire-model polynomial over clamped deflection inputs, runs quaternion transforms on compound data, and returns the summed force normalized by the total load term.

Per-frame collision damage accumulation with DNF detection: integrates impact-energy and thermal damage terms into the accumulator; on overflow marks the first non-DNF grid vehicle as DNF (state 5) and resets the damage state; otherwise applies a cosine-modulated damage response and writes a reciprocal damage output.

Initializes the vehicle physics body name-to-index mapping: loads the joint system, allocates a per-body joint data array (48 bytes per body), and resolves named physics bodies (body, steering arms, wheels, spindles, rear axle, fuel tank, driver head) via linear search. Called from TireModelInit.

Sets collision contact flags for one wheel (281-DWORD per-wheel stride): always marks the per-wheel contact flag; when in contact ORs flag bit 1 into matching body-pair contact entries; otherwise scans the two wheel-body contact lists and ORs flag bit 1 into matching entries. Invoked by RepairServiceStateDispatcher.

Per-frame engine durability, thermal and component-failure simulation: applies RPM/load durability damage and flags durability-exhausted state (code 9), runs coupled coolant and oil temperature dynamics, and drives a random component-failure/repair state machine over the component health block. Called per frame from VehiclePhysicsIntegrationStep.

Core per-frame suspension and wheel dynamics solver: per-wheel constraint projection, tire spring/damper curves, slip-force target, then a time-stepped LCP solve over a 6x7 constraint matrix; applies resolved impulses to the chassis and wheel body force accumulators. Called from WheelDataCopy and PhysicsStepFrame.

Boolean vehicle-active check: returns 0 when the thresholds at this+1DB4 or this+19C are <= 0.0 or the active flag at this+1C59 is zero; returns 1 when the override flag at this+1D0C is set; otherwise combines the secondary-state byte at *(this+1F00)+344C with prior condition-code flags.

Updates suspension-vibration state: always sets the active flag this+1C59; when the accumulator is below the threshold, either copies source values into accumulator/rate (trigger mode) or computes a noise-based vibration output from the flt_8AB274 table.

Destroys and frees up to five physics sub-component pointers (four-slot loop at this+4C, tail at this+5C), recursively destroying non-null sub-components, freeing them via FreeWrapper_7bcf and clearing the slots.

classes.name: VehiclePhysicsSimulation
classes.responsibility: Per-vehicle physics simulation state: tire-force computation, collision-damage accumulation with DNF detection, physics-body name-to-index mapping, wheel collision contact flagging, engine durability/thermal and component-failure simulation, the suspension/wheel LCP solver, the vehicle-active gate, and suspension-vibration state. The dominant object of the packet; 8 of the 16 functions operate on it.

classes.name: PhysicsCollisionShape
classes.responsibility: Physics collision-shape initializer: writes the discriminator word at this+8, the subtype constant at this+1C (2 or 4), and the external data pointer at this+20, stores inverse mass and six constant fields via CollisionInvMassStore/F_6FieldBulkSetter, and for type 2 writes four shape constants into the sub-struct at this+20. Honors an a4 override through ShortComputation_e770.

classes.name: WheelGroupDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Wheel input record dispatch and typed physics-state update. Decodes a packed 36-byte wheel record into a 6-bit group selector and 13 scaled floats, validates per-group wheel indices against the count/base pointer pairs (this+24/28, +30/34, +3C/40, +48/4C, +54/58, +60/64), resolves sentinel (-1) slots through the 4656-stride repair-state owner arrays (dword_5ECF0C / dword_5ED3AC / dword_5ED3F0 / dword_5ED434) via ShortComputation_e770 and RepairServiceStateDispatcher, and converts the slot physics state. The typed update (types 3/4/5) reuses the same group-3/4/5 bases and owner arrays.

classes.name: VehicleSelectionController
classes.responsibility: Vehicle selection and camera-target glue over the global vehicle pointer array (dword_7C54F0) and the player/tracked indices (dword_7C54DC / dword_7C54E4). Routes game-state changes through GameStateDispatchChain and refreshes vehicle visual entries.

classes.name: AudioPhysicsMixer
classes.responsibility: Averages a packed array of elements, lerps the average with the object bounding-box center using a mode-selected blend factor, combines a queried three-field offset, writes it back, and applies the offset vector to the object. Used on the frame path by audio and vehicle subsystems.

classes.name: ChassisBodyObject
classes.responsibility: Layout-only GUESS type for the physics body objects reached through this+0x15F0 and this+0x141C: three read axes, three torque-moment reads (body A), and a three-component force accumulator written by the suspension solver. No member function in this packet; identity unproven.

classes.name: WheelBodyObject
classes.responsibility: Layout-only GUESS type for the four chassis-body pointer objects at this+0x3E8, this+0x84C, this+0xCB0 and this+0x1114, each exposing three body rows at +0x1C/+0x34/+0x4C read by the suspension solver. No member function in this packet; identity unproven.

classes.name: PhysicsSubComponentOwner
classes.responsibility: Container of up to five physics sub-component pointers: a four-slot loop over dwords at this+4C and a tail pointer at this+5C, each recursively destroyed, freed via FreeWrapper_7bcf and cleared. Owner class of the recursive destroyer at 0x00448570; identity unproven.

classes.name: EnginePowerSubStruct
classes.responsibility: Layout-only GUESS type for the engine-power sub-struct reached through this+0x1D4: a power scale factor and its reciprocal written on the surviving durability path. No member function in this packet.

classes.name: SecondaryStateObject
classes.responsibility: Layout-only GUESS type for the secondary/failure state object reached through this+0x1F00: a secondary-state byte at +0x344C consumed by the vehicle-active gate and the failure-state slot at +0x4068 written by engine durability (code 9) and component-failure (code 1) paths.

state_machines.name: EngineComponentFailureRepairStateMachine
state_machines.transitions: countdown_active -> failure_triggered when this+1DB4 (countdown) reaches zero, writing failure code 1 into the failure-state slot at *(this+1F00)+4068; failure_triggered -> component_selected when a random sample (flt_8AAE74/dword_8AAE70) below 0.5 picks one of the three component health fields; failure_triggered -> component_reset when the sample is >= 0.5 and resets a component pair to 1.0; both converge on repair_drift, where zero components drift back toward 1.0 while the time array is cleared.

state_machines.name: CollisionDnfDetectionStateMachine
state_machines.transitions: accumulating -> overflow when the damage accumulator update raises FPU overflow flags; overflow -> dnf_marked scans dword_7C54F0[0..dword_5C329C) for the first vehicle with its DNF flag unset and writes state 5 at veh+16436+52; dnf_marked -> damage_reset zeroes this+42C/430/3E4/3E8.

interfaces.name: GameStateDispatch
interfaces.purpose: Routes a game-state change for a selected or tracked vehicle; called by the vehicle selection cycle and the camera-target wrapper.

interfaces.name: PhysicsElementInitWithOverride
interfaces.purpose: Initializes a physics element (wheel slot, engine element, collision shape) and optionally overrides the returned value through a continuation argument; shared by the wheel dispatcher, the typed state update and both shape initializers.

interfaces.name: PackedArrayAccess
interfaces.purpose: Reads a packed array of elements: obtains the linked-list node, the element count and each element pointer. Used by the audio physics mixer to average all elements.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleActiveGateContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement executable must reproduce the vehicle-active gate: the vehicle is inactive when the doubles at this+1DB4 or this+19C are <= 0.0 or the byte at this+1C59 is zero; it is active when the byte at this+1D0C is non-zero; otherwise the result combines the secondary-state byte at *(this+1F00)+344C with the preceding comparison flags.

compatibility_contracts.name: DnfMarkingContract
compatibility_contracts.description: When the collision damage accumulator overflows, the first grid vehicle (dword_7C54F0 over dword_5C329C entries) whose DNF flag is unset must be marked DNF (state 5) and the damage state reset.

compatibility_contracts.name: EngineFailureStateContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Exhausting engine durability writes failure code 9 and a component failure writes code 1 into the failure-state slot at *(this+1F00)+4068 when that slot is clear.

compatibility_contracts.name: RepairSlotOwnershipContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Wheel slots holding the sentinel -1 must be resolved through the 4656-stride repair-state owner arrays (dword_5ECF0C / dword_5ED3AC / dword_5ED3F0 / dword_5ED434) and initialized via ShortComputation_e770 and RepairServiceStateDispatcher before physics-state conversion.

compatibility_contracts.name: WheelContactFlagContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Per-wheel contact flags (this[281*a2+276] and this[281*a2+291]) and the flag-bit-1 ORs into body-pair and wheel-body contact entries must be reproduced for collision-driven behavior.

unresolved: Contradiction: this+3E8 is written as the front-left wheel index by VehiclePhysicsBodyNameMapping, is zeroed in the collision-damage DNF reset, and is dereferenced as a chassis-body pointer by SolveSuspensionWheelDynamics; the packet does not reconcile these three uses.

Contradiction: this+15B4 is read as a wheel-body contact-list count by WheelCollisionContactFlagSetter, but the analysis fill labels it the wheel contact state; the raw source reads the contact state from the per-wheel offset this[281*a2+251].

Contradiction: this+8 is read as an RPM-like excitation term by EngineStressSimulation and as the timestep by SolveSuspensionWheelDynamics; same offset, two semantic roles within the same proposed owner object.

Offset reuse across proposed owner types with no proven common ownership: this+4C and this+58 are wheel-group slot bases in WheelGroupDispatcher and also sub-component pointers in PhysicsSubComponentOwner; this+1CFC is both the tire-curve table pointer and the component-time array pointer; this+C30 is both a tire load bias and an LCP coefficient.

The object identities behind this+15F0, this+141C, this+1D4, this+1F00 and the four wheel bodies (this+3E8/84C/CB0/1114) are unknown; ChassisBodyObject, WheelBodyObject, EnginePowerSubStruct and SecondaryStateObject are layout-only GUESS types with no member functions in this packet.

The per-wheel 281-DWORD stride and the contact-record entry offsets (+4 body A id, +12 body B id, +44 wheel-contact flag, +68 body-pair contact flag) are decompiler-derived and have no field evidence refs.
The read-only global float pool (0x0059E420..0x0059ED20 plus 0x005EB978) is rendered as immediates in the raw source; the mapping between globals and constants is not independently established.
The a4 continuation argument of the shape initializers, the a2 blend-mode of AudioPhysicsMixWithLerp, and the tracked-vehicle index dword_7C54E4 are caller-defined and not grounded in this packet.
The repair-state owner arrays (dword_5ECF0C / dword_5ED3AC / dword_5ED3F0 / dword_5ED434) use a 4656-byte stride with 74*v30 / 17*v35 sub-indexing; the meaning of the sub-indexing is not decoded.
sub_5677B0 (6x6 LCP solve), ConstraintProjectGramSchmidt, sub_5881F0 and sub_41AC50 are opaque callees whose bodies fall outside this packet's evidence.
